configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Host-level settings of the gateway: which host applications modules may reach, which network interfaces and ranges are off limits, and how users can sign in.

hostApplications.title: Host applications
hostApplications.description: Applications on the host that a module may talk to through a socket.
hostApplications.name: Name

hostNetItfBlacklist.title: Blocked network interfaces
hostNetItfBlacklist.description: Host interfaces that modules must not bind to.

hostNetRngBlacklist.title: Blocked network ranges
hostNetRngBlacklist.description: Address ranges modules must not reach.

register.title: Add user
register.description: Create a user account that can sign in to this gateway.

editAccount.title: Change password
editAccount.description: Set a new password for this account.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Long-running operations the gateway performed. Setup and module changes run as jobs.

listApps.title: Applications
listApps.description: Devices and applications paired with this gateway. Each holds its own account.

empty.title: No applications paired
empty.message: Pair an application to give it its own account on this gateway.

listUsers.title: Users
listUsers.description: People who can sign in to this gateway.

empty.title: No users
empty.message: No user accounts exist on this gateway yet.

services.title: System status
services.description: Services that make up the gateway itself — the containers of the core installation and the natively installed components.

nativeLog.title: Log
nativeLog.description: Most recent output. Increase the line count to look further back.

singleSignOn.title: Single sign-on
singleSignOn.description: Let users sign in through an OpenID Connect provider. Saving restarts the identity service.
singleSignOn.loadFailed: The single sign-on settings could not be loaded.
singleSignOn.issuerUrlHint: Exactly as the provider states it in its discovery document, trailing slash included.
singleSignOn.clientSecretHint: No secret is stored yet. It is required while single sign-on is enabled.
singleSignOn.clientSecretNewProvider: A new identity provider needs its client secret.
singleSignOn.clientSecretStored: A secret is stored and never shown again. Leave the field empty to keep it, or enter a new one to replace it.
singleSignOn.scopeHint: Separated by spaces, for example: openid email profile
singleSignOn.scopeOpenid: Must include openid while single sign-on is enabled.
singleSignOn.externalUrlHint: The address users open the gateway under, without a path. The provider sends them back there after signing in.
singleSignOn.callbackUrlHint: Register this address as the redirect URI of the client at the provider.
singleSignOn.callbackUrlAfterSave: The callback URL depends on the issuer and is shown here once the settings are saved.
singleSignOn.required: Required while single sign-on is enabled.
singleSignOn.invalidUrl: Enter an http or https URL.
singleSignOn.invalidOrigin: Enter an http or https address without a path, for example https://gateway.example.org.
